# Timer

The adaptive Pomodoro: a ring countdown with session dots and a line that explains why the session is this long.

`CLR.Timer` · Focus and timer

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Timer phase={…} remainingSeconds={0} totalSeconds={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Timer" phase="{{…}}" remaining-seconds="{{0}}" total-seconds="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (TimerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `phase` * | `'idle' \| 'work' \| 'short_break' \| 'long_break'` |  |
| `remainingSeconds` * | `number` |  |
| `totalSeconds` * | `number` |  |
| `sessionsCompleted` * | `number` | Completed focus sessions in the current set of 4. |
| `loadAtStart` | `number` | Load at the moment the length was chosen, 0–1. Drives the "why this length" line. |
| `why` | `string` | Override the why line, e.g. "15 min because your load is high (78%)." |
| `size` | `number` |  |
| `onStart` | `() => void` |  |
| `onPause` | `() => void` |  |
| `onSkip` | `() => void` |  |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  |
